nodes.label: Seven execution stages and completion gates
nodes.summary: Start complete audit then implement bounded findings through reliability, visual/content, motion/input/sound, Guide/data/engineering, performance/regression and owner acceptance preparation. Continue independent work around concrete external blockers; no speculative new features/branding/backend.

nodes.label: P0 — Baseline and full audit.
nodes.summary: Inventory routes/components/states, inspect saved references and capture the baseline. Create the ledger with severity, user impact, source files and acceptance criteria. Run baseline checks once; distinguish existing failures. Choose the first bounded slice from observed issues, prioritizing broken navigation, inaccessible content and phone clipping. Audit should lead into implementation without another broad planning interview.

nodes.label: P1 — Reliability and usability.
nodes.summary: Fix actual blockers, navigation/focus defects, inaccessible paths, missing/error/recovery states and mobile overflow. Preserve the accepted interaction contract.

nodes.label: P2 — Complete visual and content pass.
nodes.summary: Apply consistent hierarchy, spacing, type, materials, controls and readable Thai/English content across every surface, including explorer and fallback. Use existing tokens/helpers; inspect real rendered results. Do not replace approved artwork/branding.

nodes.label: P3 — Motion, sound and input pass.
nodes.summary: Refine transitions as one connected journey, including rapid interruption and return. Preserve effects and adjustable orbit; optimize expensive effects using measurements.

nodes.label: P4 — Guide, data and engineering pass.
nodes.summary: Complete chat/narration/error-state polish, audit trust boundaries, fix measured maintainability issues and update meaningful tests. These areas are also checked in earlier waves when affected.

nodes.label: P5 — Performance and full regression.
nodes.summary: Exercise dense fixtures and graphics recovery; measure on available hardware, compare before/after. Resolve regressions, update docs and complete the ledger.

nodes.label: P6 — Owner acceptance and release preparation.
nodes.summary: Supply before/after evidence, test results, outstanding physical-device/brand/production dependencies, deployment/rollback steps and a reviewable final diff. Publish only within a current explicit release assignment.

nodes.label: Implementation concern map
nodes.summary: Starting files group selection/navigation, materials/layout, scene/awards, characters/chat, data, Gemini boundaries and build/review tooling. Paths are starting points; verify callers and files before editing.
